His teacher said he will do "great things". |id = SCARF_1, MASTER_SCARF_1 }} '''Scarf''' is the {{MobCategory|Boss}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor II]] within [[The Catacombs]] [[Dungeon]]. == Collection == Killing Scarf increases the Scarf dungeon collection. {{CollectionTable|Scarf}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == The '''Scarf''' fight has two distinct phases. In the '''first phase''', '''Scarf''' is protected by a barrier (reversed world border), preventing players from attacking him. Players must defeat Scarf's Undeads, which include an {{MobSprite|Undead Priest}}, {{MobSprite|Undead Mage}}, {{MobSprite|Undead Warrior}}, and {{MobSprite|Undead Archer}}. Each of the Undead works differently and use attacks or abilities corresponding to their role. In the '''second phase''', the barrier protecting '''Scarf''' disappears, and begins attacking players directly. All the Undead are also revived and become stronger. Scarf acts similar to the Warrior but uses many more abilities and is stronger. * It is recommended to kill the {{MobSprite|Undead Priest}} first in this phase, as he will heal Scarf if you do not kill him fast enough. === Attacks === '''Scarf''' and each mob will run towards the player to attack them. They also have additional, special attacks, as listed below: {|class="wikitable" ! Mob ! Attacks |- | Scarf | * {{AN|Skull Barrage}} - Scarf rises into the air, hovering slightly above the ground and barraging all players with explosive Wither Skeleton skulls. This move fires in a wide arc, causing many of the shots to miss or strike other players. Ghosts can tank the skulls from this ability. * {{AN|Soul Sand Blizzard}} - Scarf summons soul sand blocks in a path towards the player, dealing a percentage{{InfoNeeded}} of the player's max {{Stat|Health}} as {{Stat|True Damage}} to players who step in it. This also gives slowness and decreased FOV. |- | {{MobSprite|Undead Warrior}} | * {{AN|Charge}} - Occasionally charges at the player, dealing {{Red|0.3x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|864|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode, or {{Red|1x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|54,000|icononly=yes}}) in [[Master Mode]]. |- | {{MobSprite|Undead Archer}} | * {{AN|Arrow Barrage}} - Shoots a large number of arrows in all directions. * {{AN|Teleport}} - Teleport himself away from danger, or a player into danger (Usually Warrior's charge). * {{AN|Help}} - Calls for help, causing the Warrior to perform a Warrior's Charge to the player who dealt the most damage to the archer, |- | {{MobSprite|Undead Mage}} | * {{AN|Wither Skulls}} - Shoots wither skulls towards the player while standing still, dealing {{Red|0.45x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|1,094.4|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode and {{Red|0.65x}} ({{Stat|Damage|29,640|icononly=yes}}) it in [[Master Mode]]. * {{AN|Magma Pit}} - Deals {{Red|0.15x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|364.8|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode and {{Red|0.6x}} ({{Stat|Damage|27,360|icononly=yes}}) it in [[Master Mode]]. * {{AN|Tsunami}} - Creates a wave that deals {{Red|0.25x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|608|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode and {{Red|0.5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|22,800|icononly=yes}}) in [[Master Mode]].{{Cite Discord |url = https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1554515558685483030 |user = mrkeith |staff = yes |date = 9/29/26, 11:29 AM (EST) |text =
how is the damage for the undead mage (scarf fight)'s tsunami calculated?
Base scarf mage damage is 2432
Master scarf mage damage is 45600 Tsunami damage multiplier is 0.25x for normal, 0.5x for master }} * {{AN|Help}} - Calls for help, causing the {{MobSprite|Undead Warrior}} to perform a Warrior's Charge to the player who dealt the most damage to the mage. |- | {{MobSprite|Undead Priest}} | * {{AN|Heal}} - Heals up itself and nearby Undeads. * {{AN|Help}} - Calls for help, causing the {{MobSprite|Undead Warrior}} to perform a Warrior's Charge to the player who dealt the most damage to the priest. |} === Summoned Mobs === {{Mob Table| {{Mob Table Row|Undead Warrior}} {{Mob Table Row|Undead Archer}} {{Mob Table Row|Undead Mage}} {{Mob Table Row|Undead Priest}} }} === Master Mode Changes === * Scarf has {{Hp|375M}} and his Undeads have significantly more {{Hp}}. His attacks deal much more damage. * In both phases, 2 of each type of Undead spawn instead of 1. * In the 2nd phase, Scarf gains damage resistance based on how many Undeads are alive. He will be completely immune to damage until at least 4 undeads are defeated. == Drops == Killing Scarf directly grants the following drops: {{Mob Drops Table |level = 286-855 |coins = 715-2,137 |combat_xp = 2,145-6,412 |orbs = 858-2,565 }} Defeating him will also complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor II/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor II/Master Mode Loot}} == Variants == {{Mob Variants |level = 286 |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor II]] |health = 1,000,000 |damage = 3,456 |coins = 715 |combat_xp = 2,145 |orbs = 858 |id = SCARF_1 |level2 = 855 |spawn_location2 = [[The Catacombs - Floor II|The Master Mode Catacombs - Floor II]] |health2 = 375,000,000 |damage2 = 81,000 |coins2 = 2,137 |combat_xp2 = 6,412 |orbs2 = 2,565 |id2 = MASTER_SCARF_1 }} == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#Scarf}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Intro | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: This is where the journey ends for you, Adventurers. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: The last few who tried fighting me are now in those Crypts. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: If you can beat my Undeads, I'll personally grant you the privilege to replace them. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: ARISE, MY CREATIONS! &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: This should be interesting. }} |- | class="ct" | Start of Phase 2 | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: Those toys are not strong enough I see. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: Don't get too excited though. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: Did you forget? I'll take you myself!}} |- | class="ct" | After dealing major damage to {{MobSprite|Scarf}} | {{Dialogue|&c[BOSS] Scarf&f: That was nothing my Priest can't heal!}} |- | class="ct" | If the players have lost | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: I always knew I would win...I'm a genius. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: But don't worry I'll add you to my collection. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: In a way, you'll live forever... }} |- | class="ct" | If the players have won | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: Whatever... &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: You'll never beat my teacher.. &c[BOSS] Scarf&f: His technique.. is too advanced.. }} |- |} == Trivia == * A reason Scarf was the top student in his class was that he hoped he could bring his mother back. This is suggested by the [[Red Scarf]] reforge stone, as his mother knit him that Scarf. * One of Scarf's dialogue lines is "''Yare yare daze''"; this is a reference to JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. * Another of Scarf's dialogue lines is "''Necro no Jutsu!''"; this is a reference to Naruto. * Another is "''If you win, you live. If you lose, you die. If you don't fight, you can't win.''" which is most likely a reference to Attack on Titan. * The [[Adaptive Blade]], a drop from Scarf, is a reference that Scarf and all his Undead represent all the classes players can choose from, with Scarf being the [[Tank]]. * Scarf is revived by [[The Watcher]] on [[The Catacombs - Floor 4|Floor 4]] , [[The Catacombs - Floor V|5]] , [[The Catacombs - Floor VI|6]] only having Scarf in his Second phase. * When Scarf summoned as Undead is defeated, it doesn't add to the collection. * The Undead Warrior(s) is/are currently bugged to charge up {{stat|True Damage}} instead of regular Damage.{{Confirm}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/June 24|Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|3,870|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|3,456|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|90,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|81,000|icononly=yes}}.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|286-855}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|715-2,137}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|200}} to {{Dark Aqua|858-2,565}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|300-450}} to {{Dark Aqua|2,145-6,412}}.}} |beta= {{History|2020/July 7|[[File:Scarf.png|26px]] Added '''Scarf'''.}} {{History|0.26.1|Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|3,870|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|3,456|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|90,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|81,000|icononly=yes}}.}} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|286-855}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|715-2,137}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|200}} to {{Dark Aqua|858-2,565}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|300-450}} to {{Dark Aqua|2,145-6,412}}.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Nav/Catacombs}} [[Category:Dungeons]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Catacombs]] [[Category:Boss Collections]]
